sources.title: GitHub - lingcco/EventMemAgent: EventMemAgent: Hierarchical Event ...
sources.snippet: EventMemAgent is an active online video agent framework based on hierarchical memory. It employs a dual-layer strategy: short-term memory detects event boundaries and uses event-granular reservoir sampling; long-term memory archives past observations on an event-by-event basis.

sources.title: EventMemAgent: Hierarchical Event-Centric Memory for Online Video ...
sources.snippet: We employ Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [2] as the backbone MLLM for EventMemAgent, using Grounding DINO [19] as the object detection model and Deepseek-OCR [31] as the OCR model. By default, input videos are sampled at 1 FPS, and the maximum ca-pacity of short-term memory is set to 32. The content con-sistency threshold δ is set to 0.2.
